implementation_findings: OBS-1 (PRE-EXISTING, not this slice, not scope related): a join clause with a string type on the wire ("type": "left") raises ArgumentError invalid join qualifier from Compiler.add_hop_join/4 (parse_join_clause/1 passes the string through; the compiler needs :left). The wire therefore cannot express a LEFT join; HTTP join tests use the default INNER join and LEFT stays covered at the compiler layer (2c-i-a). Route to ISSUE-FIXER / an issue; no 2c-i-b change needed.

OBS-2 (design vs code, low): design 4.2 says a :pending_sec_ruling entry is 'printed by the walk in a stable line the PR body copies'; the code only validates the marker and prints nothing. T-S8 therefore pins the shipped list (none pending) and the marker rules, not a printed line.

OBS-3 (SEC step-12 F-2, still open, optional): the walk does not report an unmounted list entry or an entry whose key differs from the route's; the new real-table test checks that every shipped entry IS mounted with the same class, key and declared source, so the shipped list cannot drift silently, and one test documents the current behavior for a synthetic unmounted entry.
NO IMPLEMENTATION BUG FOUND in the 2c-i-b working tree: no test is red against it and all 36 mutants of it are killed.
